checks.movement: Sampled every 2 seconds: satellite platform, walking on runway, arrival at main stage visible. Venue and costume broadly retained.
checks.chorus: Sampled every second: arena wide 0-5s, singing close-up 5-10s, rear main-stage wide 10-15s. No karaoke room or sheet labels visible.
checks.lip_sync: Reference/source compared at one-second intervals. Gesture trajectory differs: source raises arm then lowers across face, generated starts with arm across face then raises/lowers. Not frame-exact performance replication; complete phoneme sync is NOT certified.
checks.audio: Original source song 7-37s then 72-87s, speed unchanged. Image-reference movement crowd is crossfaded into a continuous bed; all video-reference generated audio discarded. Listening not verified.
checks.asr: Local Whisper-small used for rough screening. Source recognition has severe hallucination/repetition and nonmonotonic timestamps; not used as exact lyric/timing authority. Crowd ASR likewise repeats tokens and cannot certify absence of speech.

limitations: Generated close-up is a reconstruction, not pixel-preserved source.
Lip-sync fidelity remains a test result rather than a confirmed match.
